title: Leg — one played card in a Cornucopia atelier (spec 002 FR-007/FR-012, spec 003 FR-009)
description: Each leg is persisted as its own JSON file named leg-{NNN}-{playerSlug}.json inside the atelier folder. Written with validation=PENDING and precisions=[] when the card is played, updated in place as precisions arrive, and finally flipped to VALIDATED or REJECTED after the vote. The 5-field shape is UNCHANGED from spec 002; in spec 003 cardName is a REAL Cornucopia card id (e.g. VE2) that references a full Card (with description) stored in the atelier's deck (atelier.json) — see contracts/atelier-schema.json and research R-016.

cardName.description: Real id of the played card (spec 003), e.g. VE2 — references a Card in atelier.json deck

scenario.description: Threat scenario evoked by the player, built from the card's real description

explanation.description: The player's explanation of the scenario

precisions.description: Precisions added by the other players and 'Je sais' answers to their questions. Empty list when the card is first played.

validation.description: PENDING when written, then VALIDATED iff strictly more than half of the voters (all players except the card player) answered yes, else REJECTED
